core.title: Modern Aluminum Cabinet Pull, Omnia AL404

text.description_html:
Omnia AL404 Modern Aluminum Cabinet Hardware

Available in either a 3 inch or a 6 inch length, this modern aluminum door pull is designed with the quality that Omnia takes pride in. Aluminum is less expensive than stainless steel while still granting a contemporary look to all you cabinet doors, Best of all, it is easy to clean and very durable. The aluminum (28US) finish ensures that its durability will not exclude beauty, making this cabinet pull one of the best choices around.

Omnia's line of sophisticated Aluminum cabinet hardware have been painstakingly crafted by artisans who understand that a beautiful design must be as comfortable to the hand as it is pleasing to the eyes.

Available in 2 Sizes:

  • OMN-AL404/76 - Center to Center Mount Hole Spacing: 3, Overall Length: 4-5/16", Projection: 1-1/16"
  • OMN-AL404/152 - Center to Center Mount Hole Spacing: 6", Overall Length: 9-7/16", Projection: 1-1/16"
